title: Page headline, set in capitals. Keep it short (about 12 characters).
intro: Deliberately whimsical, fantasy-flavoured invitation to write. Keep the playful, magical tone rather than a literal translation.
submit.label: Button label, shouted (capitals, exclamation mark). Must fit one pill-shaped button; about 15 characters.
submit.sending: Shown inside the button while the message sends; three animated dots are appended automatically — do not add punctuation.
submit.sent: One word inside the button after delivery, next to a check mark.
submit.held: One word inside the button when the message is kept offline to send later, next to a clock icon.
toast.heldSent: Toast after messages that were waiting offline were delivered automatically. ✦ is a decorative sparkle; keep it.
